stories.title: Skimming devices found at two gas stations in northern Colorado
stories.summary: The devices were found at a QuikTrip and Maverik in Mead.

stories.title: Man found guilty of tampering with body and evidence in Jax Gratton's death
stories.summary: Brandon Mumma, 44, was not charged with her death, but faced charges related to the investigation.

stories.title: 9Cares Colorado Shares telethon gives boost to local food banks
stories.summary: The telethon Thursday raised more than $145,000 to fight food insecurity.

stories.title: Cool Schools: Longmont school’s greenhouse gives all 665 students a hands-on science lesson
stories.summary: At Flagstaff Academy in Longmont, Colorado, a unique greenhouse program offers every student hands-on learning in horticulture.

stories.title: A mild, windy Friday for Denver
stories.summary: The winds will kick up a bit on Friday, but the Front Range stays dry with scattered snow showers in the mountains.

stories.title: Walmart proposes drone delivery hub at Arvada store, drawing neighborhood concerns
stories.summary: Some neighbors question whether faster deliveries are worth potential noise and privacy concerns. A public meeting is set for Dec. 3.

stories.title: Missing Roxborough man believed to be found dead in Park County
stories.summary: Tyler Barton was last seen on the morning of Nov. 16, police said. A body found Thursday is believed to be his.

stories.title: Denver Mayor Mike Johnston's appointees may receive up to 60% raises in 2027
stories.summary: A new City Council proposal would give big raises to the city's 12 charter officers, which the bill sponsor says are long overdue.

stories.title: Was it really an accident? | Podcast raises new questions about CU student's 1985 death
stories.summary: Police initially arrested man on suspicion of murder, then dropped the case after the coroner concluded young woman simply fell into a canal.

stories.title: Denver ambulances arrive minutes later than the city’s goal. Starting Monday, 911 will change who gets help first
stories.summary: A three-month test will sort medical calls by urgency and send crews to some less serious calls without lights and sirens.

stories.title: Long-awaited Skyland grocery store opens, seeking to address food desert in north Denver
stories.summary: The shop, at Madison and 28th, also has a café, seating space and a sister wine bar next door.

stories.title: DPS appoints a new member to serve on the board following the resignation of DJ Torres last month
stories.summary: The Denver Public Schools board of education voted 4-2 Thursday evening to appoint Caron Blanke as the board member representing District 3.
